pages.text: $(item)Harmonic of Divination$()$(br2)A frequency that echoes back the location of a single, chosen material.
$(bold)Attunement$()$(br)Strike an Unattuned Fork against Budding Amethyst. This will tune it to become the Harmonic of Divination.

$(bold)Use$()$(br)Right-click any block to tune the fork to that material. Once tuned, left-clicking will send out a searching pulse. If a block of that type is found nearby, a trail of guiding particles will point the way toward it.$(br2)The search has a cooldown between uses, so choose your moment with intention as you may not always receive a hit.
